bias.en: Neutral to bearish · slipping under the $356 shelf
bias.zh: 中性偏空 · 跌破 $356 平台

read.en: Broadcom fell 1.9% on Oct 12 to $354.73 and is below all its averages: the 5, 10 and 30-day ($358–366), 200-day ($368) and 100-day ($383). MACD is still above its signal but below zero, and the histogram has faded from 3.7 to 1.6. Parabolic SAR is bullish but close at $347, and RSI is 46.
read.zh: 博通 10月12日下跌 1.9%，收于 $354.73，位于全部均线下方：5 日、10 日和 30 日（$358–366）、200 日（$368）及 100 日（$383）。MACD 仍在信号线上方但位于零轴下方，柱体由 3.7 降至 1.6。抛物线 SAR 仍看多，但已贴近于 $347，RSI 为 46。

read.en: The close slipped just under the $356 shelf that had held seven times. If SAR at $347 breaks, the Oct 1 low of $343 and the Sep 16 low of $336 come next, then $311.5. A recovery needs to reclaim $358–366 and then the 200-day at $368–371, which has turned the stock back five times; the 100-day near $383 caps the bigger picture.
read.zh: 收盘价略微跌破曾七次守住的 $356 平台。若 $347 的 SAR 失守，下看 10月1日低点 $343 和 9月16日低点 $336，再看 $311.5。要修复，需收复 $358–366，再站上曾五次压回股价的 $368–371（200 日均线）；更大格局受约 $383 的 100 日均线压制。
